calls.name: status
delete_backup
events
whitelist

initialize.instructions: Run and moderate a Horizon (Minecraft Java Edition 26.3) server. Start with status and players. Moderation tools (kick, ban, pardon, ban_ip, op, whitelist...) run vanilla's console commands and answer `changed` and the console's lines; events and logs read what happened since a number they return. Destructive tools that can't be undone need confirm: true.

tools.description: How the server does: phase, uptime, crashes, TPS, MSPT, players, RAM, CPU, updates
tools.name: status

tools.description: Who is online (address, ping, position, op level), the operators, the whitelist and the bans
tools.name: players

tools.description: Run a console command (as vanilla's server console) and return what it logged
tools.name: run_command

tools.description: The log lines after the since-th (the last 2000 are kept); returns next to ask from
tools.name: logs

tools.description: What happened after event number since: joins, leaves, kicks, chat, deaths, log lines, phase changes; returns next
tools.name: events

tools.description: Kick an online player
tools.name: kick

tools.description: Ban a player (kicked if online)
tools.name: ban

tools.description: Lift a player's ban
tools.name: pardon

tools.description: Ban an address, or the address an online player plays from (its players are kicked)
tools.name: ban_ip

tools.description: Lift an address's ban
tools.name: pardon_ip

tools.description: Make a player an operator
tools.name: op

tools.description: Make a player no longer an operator
tools.name: deop

tools.description: Change the whitelist: add or remove a player, or turn it on or off
tools.name: whitelist

tools.description: The backups, newest first
tools.name: list_backups

tools.description: Back up the world and settings now (a running server saves first and stays up)
tools.name: backup

tools.description: Delete a backup
tools.name: delete_backup

tools.description: Restart the server with a backup's world, or with one dimension of it (what it replaces is kept in backups/)
tools.name: restore

tools.description: The settings in server.toml
tools.name: get_config

tools.description: Change settings, e.g. {"world.difficulty": "hard"}; says which apply now and which at the next start
tools.name: set_config

tools.description: Start the server in the background and wait until the game is up
tools.name: start

tools.description: Restart the game (players are disconnected for a moment)
tools.name: restart

tools.description: Stop the game and horizon-server
tools.name: stop
